title: Server vs Client Components — How Do They Work in Next.js?
excerpt: Next.js allows us to handle server-side operations while keeping interactive features on the client.
body:
ㅤ
📘 Engineering Notes | From Concepts to Code — Post 17
ㅤ
When I started working with Next.js, one interesting concept was the difference between Server Components and Client Components.

Next.js allows us to handle server-side operations while keeping interactive features on the client.

But when should we use each?
ㅤ
1️⃣ 𝗦𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗻𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀

In the Next.js App Router, Server Components are used by default.

They allow us to fetch data and render content on the server.

For example, an e-commerce product page can fetch product details directly on the server.

Benefits:
• Access to server-side data sources
• Less client-side JavaScript
• Keep sensitive operations on the server
ㅤ
2️⃣ 𝗖𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗻𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀

Client Components are useful when we need user interaction or browser features.

We mark them using "use client".

Example:

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

export default function Counter() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);

  return (
    <button onClick={() => setCount(c => c + 1)}>
      Count: {count}
    </button>
  );
}

Client Components support:
• React hooks like useState
• Event handlers
• Browser APIs
ㅤ
3️⃣ 𝗥𝗲𝗮𝗹-𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱 𝗘𝘅𝗮𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗲

Think about an e-commerce application.

Server Components:
• Product details
• Server-side data fetching

Client Components:
• Add to Cart button
• Quantity selector
• Interactive filters

We don't need to make an entire page a Client Component just because one button needs interaction.

Also, Client Components can be prerendered on the server for the initial page load.
ㅤ
𝗠𝘆 𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗧𝗮𝗸𝗲𝗮𝘄𝗮𝘆

Good frontend architecture is about choosing the right component for each responsibility.

Use Server Components for server-side work and Client Components when interaction is needed.

Small decisions like these help us build more efficient and maintainable applications.
ㅤ
How do you decide between Server and Client Components in your Next.js projects?
